body_replaced_cannot_convert.why: a stand-in body for A.two (0n) cannot convert to 2n: replacing a body by a signature-level stub breaks consumers

conversion_ok.why: B's proof {A.two() == 2n} converts by unfolding A.two's body

dependency_body_changed.why: A.two now returns 3n: the consumer proof breaks, so a dependency BODY is part of its interface

filled_law_usable.why: a law is usable once a checked def fills it

filler_loaded_before_user_passes.why: U uses Laws.L but does NOT import the filler P; the entry loads P first, and the fill is visible to U

filler_never_loaded_fails.why: the filler exists on disk but is never imported by anything: not visible (no implicit sibling lookup)

forward_reference_rejected.why: a call to a def written below is an unfilled definition (defs must precede use)

mutual_recursion_rejected.why: mutual recursion is not allowed: the callee below is an unfilled definition

unfilled_law_unusable.why: a law with no fill is a dead claim; the compiler itself refuses to assume a statement

unsafe_scc_flagged.why: @unsafe defs may recurse freely and call below, but are named in the unsafe notice

unsafe_taint_propagates.why: a def that calls an @unsafe def is itself reported as relying on unsafe code

user_loaded_before_filler_fails.why: identical files, but the entry loads U before P: the fill is not yet visible, so the fill context depends on load order
